_meta.batch: Symmetry 04 STATEMENT (42 terminow) - kontynuacja luku Symmetry po batch_27-28 (40/292). Symmetry recytuje swoje zeznanie jako PELNOPRAWNY SCENARIUSZ TEATRALNY (didaskalia w nawiasach kwadratowych, imiona postaci WIELKIMI LITERAMI + dwukropek + kwestia) - zgodne z jej tozsamoscia aktorki/iluzjonistki teatralnej. Potwierdza tez, ze inne postacie zwracaja sie do Dirka per 'Dansom' (nazwisko).
_meta.character_voice: Symmetry: archaiczny/teatralny (patrz batch_27-28). W tej scenie dodatkowo format scenariusza - didaskalia [w nawiasach], imiona postaci WIELKIMI LITERAMI, struktura 'IMIE:\n(didaskalium)\nkwestia' zachowana doslownie z oryginalu.

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en:
[Scene opens]
[Submarine, interior]
[SYMMETRY lies awake in bed]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl:
[Scena się otwiera]
[Łódź podwodna, wnętrze]
[SYMMETRY leży w łóżku, rozbudzona]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [A sudden movement of the submarine wakes SINTHIA]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [Nagły ruch łodzi budzi SINTHIĘ]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en:
SINTHIA:
(noticing SYMMETRY)
O, You were already awake? What is wrong?
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl:
SINTHIA:
(zauważając SYMMETRY)
O, już nie spałaś? Co się stało?
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en:
[The ILLUSION THEATRE]
[The door is already open]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl:
[TEATR ILUZJI]
[Drzwi są już otwarte]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [She also sees a large FACE passing by the window]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [Widzi też wielką TWARZ przesuwającą się za oknem]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en:
[Enter DANSOM and WIRMAN]
DANSOM:
O, My dude, this is crazy.
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl:
[Wchodzą DANSOM i WIRMAN]
DANSOM:
O, stary, to jest szalone.
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [In her wake, MR GRIPP, SINTHIA and MARIANA]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [Za nią, PAN GRIPP, SINTHIA i MARIANA]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [And after a short while, DR ZEPHYR]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [A po krótkiej chwili, DOKTOR ZEPHYR]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en:
SINTHIA:
(Getting up)
O, I must go and inspect the control room.
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl:
SINTHIA:
(wstając)
O, muszę pójść i sprawdzić sterownię.
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en:
[Exit SINTHIA]
[SYMMETRY lays in bed a little longer]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl:
[SINTHIA wychodzi]
[SYMMETRY leży w łóżku jeszcze chwilę]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en:
SYMMETRY:
(Getting up)
O, I must return to the Illusion Theatre. I cannot bear it.
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl:
SYMMETRY:
(wstając)
O, muszę wrócić do Teatru Iluzji. Nie mogę tego znieść.
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [SYMMETRY sees CAPTAIN MORTUGA, laying dead on the ground. She screams]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [SYMMETRY widzi KAPITANA MORTUGĘ, leżącego martwego na ziemi. Krzyczy]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [Enter MADAM TADPOLE]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [Wchodzi MADAM TADPOLE]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en:
MADAM TADPOLE:
(Taking charge)
O, Which one of you is the murderer?
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl:
MADAM TADPOLE:
(przejmując dowodzenie)
O, która z was jest morderczynią?
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [The two young women attempt to enter the CAPTAIN'S CABIN, but the door is locked]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [Dwie młode kobiety próbują wejść do KAJUTY KAPITANA, ale drzwi są zamknięte]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en:
SINTHIA:
(Visibly nervous)
O, But who will become captain now?
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl:
SINTHIA:
(widocznie zdenerwowana)
O, ale kto teraz zostanie kapitanem?
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [Exit SINTHIA and SYMMETRY]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [SINTHIA i SYMMETRY wychodzą]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [They decide to visit the CONTROL ROOM instead]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [Postanawiają zamiast tego odwiedzić STEROWNIĘ]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [SINTHIA is now moving with urgency, and SYMMETRY is lagging behind]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [SINTHIA porusza się teraz w pośpiechu, a SYMMETRY zostaje w tyle]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [SINTHIA emerges from the CONTROL ROOM]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [SINTHIA wyłania się ze STEROWNI]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [SINTHIA goes down the ladder. SYMMETRY follows behind]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [SINTHIA schodzi po drabinie. SYMMETRY podąża za nią]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [She places the paper back into the typewriter]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [Wkłada papier z powrotem do maszyny do pisania]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [SYMMETRY returns to her bedroom]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [SYMMETRY wraca do swojej sypialni]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [Scene ends]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [Scena się kończy]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: Return?
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: Wraca?
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [The two young women briefly talk to one another]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [Dwie młode kobiety chwilę ze sobą rozmawiają]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: Guilt about what?
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: Wina za co?
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: Not gonna give us that bit?
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: Nie dasz nam tego fragmentu?
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: What? A face - outside the submarine?
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: Co? Twarz - na zewnątrz łodzi?
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en:
SYMMETRY:
(Pondering)
O, Do you think Mortuga wrote a will?
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl:
SYMMETRY:
(zamyślona)
O, myślicie, że Mortuga spisał testament?
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: We're really doing it like this.
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: Więc naprawdę tak to robimy.
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [She is restlesss, wrought with guilt]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [Jest niespokojna, dręczona poczuciem winy]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [WIRMAN says nothing]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [WIRMAN nic nie mówi]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: I'm sure that's [i]exactly[/i] what she said.
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: Jestem pewna, że to [i]dokładnie[/i] to, co powiedziała.
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: Not a bad question.
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: Niezłe pytanie.
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [She is holding several sheets of paper and the Captain's Logbook]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [Trzyma kilka kartek papieru i Dziennik Pokładowy Kapitana]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: [Outside WIRMAN'S BUNK ROOM]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: [Przed KAJUTĄ SYPIALNĄ WIRMANA]
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en:
SYMMETRY:
(Noticing a piece of paper on the ground)
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl:
SYMMETRY:
(zauważając kartkę papieru na ziemi)
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: O, Surely this was dropped by Wirman, as it is from his typewriter. I shall return it to whence it came.
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: O, z pewnością to zgubił Wirman, skoro to z jego maszyny do pisania. Zwrócę to, skąd przybyło.
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.en: Tell me now so that ye may be punished appropriately.
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.pl: Powiedz mi teraz, byś mógł być ukarany stosownie.
Conversation/Symmetry 04 STATEMENT/Secti.speaker: Symmetry
